Speaky's Rainbow
история Speak & Smile · colours · What colour? It's red, yellow, green, blue!
тапни / стрелка →
A grey, grey day…
No colours today —
let's paint some!
🦝 I'll bring colours!
It's RED!
A red apple,
a red flower!
🦝 Red, red, red!
It's YELLOW!
A yellow sun,
a yellow flower!
🦝 Yellow, yellow!
It's GREEN!
Green grass,
a big green tree!
🦝 Green, green!
It's BLUE!
The blue sky,
the blue sea!
🦝 Blue, blue!
SPLASH! A rainbow!
All the colours on Speaky —
a rainbow raccoon! Ha, ha, ha!
🦝 Look at me!
I love colours!
Red, yellow, green and blue —
what a beautiful rainbow!
🦝🐶🐰 Hooray!
